verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a REST API with numerous endpoints (nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions, tax estimate), five official SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec, API key management, and an llms.txt for AI-native discovery, plus an MCP server exposing docs to AI assistants. Missing for 10: a publicly reachable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
